measurement_fix_c9: FROZEN-FIRST measurement correction (a_break_the_wall type-a, NOT tune-to-green). The whole-object read-out is a per-element BINARY figure/ground mask, so its chance baseline is the binary-classifier expectation ~0.50 (NOT 1/N_GROUPS=0.333), and plain accuracy LEAKS by rewarding the trivial 'almost nothing is figure' prediction (it banks the ground-majority). Fix: (1) baseline constant corrected to BINARY_CHANCE=0.50, (2) scoring switched to BALANCED accuracy = mean(figure-recall, ground-recall), applied IDENTICALLY to every read-out (grouping-ON, ablation, GWS, completion, rivalry, shuffle) — so any class-blind / single-element guess scores exactly 0.50. The binding signal `on` (0.965) and the discriminator STRUCTURE were never touched; only the metric baseline + leak were corrected. Pre-fix run showed the same on=0.964 with controls at ~0.50 (gws 0.514 / comp 0.487 / riv 0.504) — the only error was the wrong chance constant. Frozen log: state/1491_gestalt_grouping/run_h1491.local.log.
